# CarWale

> CarWale is an Indian automotive marketplace for researching, comparing, buying, and selling new and used cars.

CarWale helps users discover car prices, on-road costs, specifications, expert reviews, comparisons, mileage, images, videos, dealer information, and used car listings across Indian cities.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.carwale.com/): Main entry point for new cars, used cars, prices, reviews, and buying tools.
- [New Cars](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/): Browse new car models by brand, body type, budget, and fuel type.
- [Used Cars](https://www.carwale.com/used/): Search used cars for sale with filters for city, price, and ownership.
- [Compare Cars](https://www.carwale.com/compare-cars/): Compare multiple cars on price, specs, features, and dimensions.
- [Car Reviews](https://www.carwale.com/car-reviews/): Read expert reviews and road tests for new and updated car models.
- [Car News](https://www.carwale.com/news/): Track automotive news, launches, facelifts, and industry updates.
- [Videos](https://www.carwale.com/videos/): Watch car reviews, walkarounds, comparisons, and launch coverage.
- [Photos](https://www.carwale.com/photos/): Explore car image galleries for exteriors, interiors, and variants.

## New Car Research
- [All Brands](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/#all-brands): Browse new cars from all manufacturers available on CarWale.
- [Upcoming Cars](https://www.carwale.com/upcoming-cars/): See expected launches, estimated prices, and launch timelines in India.
- [Electric Cars](https://www.carwale.com/electric-cars/): Discover EVs with prices, range, charging, and specification details.
- [SUV Cars](https://www.carwale.com/suv-cars/): Browse SUV models available in the Indian market.
- [Hatchback Cars](https://www.carwale.com/hatchback-cars/): Explore hatchback options by price, mileage, and features.
- [Sedan Cars](https://www.carwale.com/sedan-cars/): Find sedan models with specifications, variants, and reviews.
- [Automatic Cars](https://www.carwale.com/automatic-cars/): Browse automatic transmission cars across segments and budgets.
- [Diesel Cars](https://www.carwale.com/diesel-cars/): Explore diesel car options with pricing and mileage information.

## Pricing, Variants, and Ownership Costs
- [On-Road Price](https://www.carwale.com/on-road-price/): Check city-wise on-road prices including ex-showroom, RTO, and insurance.
- [Car Loan EMI Calculator](https://www.carwale.com/car-loan-emi-calculator/): Estimate monthly EMI for car loans using price, tenure, and interest rate.
- [Mileage of Cars](https://www.carwale.com/mileage-of-cars/): Compare claimed mileage figures across car models and fuel types.
- [Car Insurance](https://www.carwale.com/car-insurance/): Learn about insurance options and ownership cost considerations.
- [Best Cars Under 10 Lakh](https://www.carwale.com/best-cars-under-10-lakh/): Curated list of cars in a popular budget segment.
- [Best Cars Under 15 Lakh](https://www.carwale.com/best-cars-under-15-lakh/): Compare value-focused options in the mid-budget range.
- [Best Cars Under 20 Lakh](https://www.carwale.com/best-cars-under-20-lakh/): Research cars across body styles in a higher budget bracket.

## Reviews, News, and Editorial
- [Expert Reviews](https://www.carwale.com/car-reviews/): In-depth expert opinions covering performance, comfort, features, and value.
- [User Reviews](https://www.carwale.com/user-reviews/): Read owner-submitted feedback on real-world usage and reliability.
- [Latest News](https://www.carwale.com/news/): Follow recent launches, updates, recalls, and market developments.
- [Web Stories](https://www.carwale.com/web-stories/): Short visual stories covering cars, launches, and buying highlights.
- [Videos](https://www.carwale.com/videos/): Video reviews, first drives, explainers, and comparison content.
- [Photos](https://www.carwale.com/photos/): Official and editorial image galleries for cars and variants.

## Used Cars and Selling
- [Used Cars in India](https://www.carwale.com/used/): Search used car listings across cities with detailed filters.
- [Used Cars in Mumbai](https://www.carwale.com/used/mumbai/): Browse second-hand cars available in Mumbai.
- [Used Cars in Delhi](https://www.carwale.com/used/delhi/): Browse second-hand cars available in Delhi.
- [Used Cars in Bangalore](https://www.carwale.com/used/bangalore/): Browse second-hand cars available in Bangalore.
- [Used Cars in Pune](https://www.carwale.com/used/pune/): Browse second-hand cars available in Pune.
- [Sell Car](https://www.carwale.com/sell-car/): Start the process of listing or selling a used car.
- [Used Car Valuation](https://www.carwale.com/used-car-valuation/): Estimate the market value of a used car before selling.

## Comparison and Discovery Tools
- [Compare Cars](https://www.carwale.com/compare-cars/): Side-by-side comparison of prices, specs, and features.
- [Find Best Car](https://www.carwale.com/best-cars/): Discover top cars by budget, body type, and use case.
- [Cars by Budget](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/#budget): Explore cars grouped by common budget ranges.
- [Cars by Fuel Type](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/#fuel-type): Filter new cars by petrol, diesel, CNG, or electric powertrain.
- [Cars by Seating Capacity](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/#seating-capacity): Find cars based on family size and seating needs.
- [Cars by Transmission](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/#transmission): Browse manual and automatic options across segments.
- [Cars by Body Type](https://www.carwale.com/new-cars/#body-type): Discover hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, MUVs, and coupes.
